$comment: World-to-minimap coordinate configuration. This is DATA, not code (decision D9):
adding a fourth map must never require a redeploy, so the app reads this at runtime
and exposes an editor for it.
scale / originX / originZ are taken from the dataset README and independently verified:
0.00% of 89,104 rows fall outside UV [0,1] on any map, hotspots land inside buildings,
99.3%+ of visited cells fall within a playable-land mask derived from the minimap art,
and the resulting movement speeds are physically plausible (median 2.52 m/s, max 12.65),
which independently confirms world units are metres.
'source' dimensions are the ACTUAL image sizes. The dataset README claims all minimaps
are 1024x1024; they are not, and GrandRift is not even square. Nothing may assume them.
'version' supports map-geometry versioning (decision D15). The supplied 5 days show no
geometry change (extents are stable across all days on all maps, and the telemetry has no
map-version field), but level designers ship map changes constantly — so behaviour data
can be tagged to a version and compared across one when it exists.

AmbroseValley.label: Ambrose Valley
AmbroseValley.note: Primary / most played map — 566 matches (71% of all matches)

GrandRift.label: Grand Rift
GrandRift.note: Secondary map — only 59 matches (7.4%). Under-tested; 2+ humans online simultaneously just 2% of the time.

Lockdown.label: Lockdown
Lockdown.note: Smaller / close-quarters map — 171 matches (21.5%). Lowest playable-land coverage at 65%.
